# Everyone Can Light

> Lighting education, an equipment database, control-app guides and gear rentals for filmmakers and creators.

Everyone Can Light helps creators learn lighting, understand gear specifications, find the right control apps and rent professional lighting equipment for productions.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of lighting lessons, the equipment database and rentals.
- [Rent Equipment](/rent-equipment): Rental catalogue of professional lighting gear, stands, grips and props.
- [Equipment Database](/lighting-equipment): Specifications, reviews and comparisons for 250+ lighting fixtures and accessories.
- [Compare Equipment](/lighting-equipment/compare): Side-by-side specification comparison of two lights.
- [Control Apps](/control-apps): Manufacturer apps for controlling LED lights from a phone.
- [Learn](/learn): Learning paths covering articles, courses, masterclass and lighting diagrams.
- [Articles](/articles): Practical lighting guides written from real production experience.
- [Masterclass](/masterclass): Shift The Light, the annual hands-on lighting masterclass in Lagos.

## Optional

- [What is Wattage in Lighting?](/articles/what-is-wattage-in-lighting): Example lighting guide.
- [Why Your Videos Look Dark (And How to Fix It)](/articles/why-your-videos-look-dark-and-how-to-fix-it): Example problem-solving guide.
